'''Bezz Drexx's tower''' was a structure designed to ensure its [[Bezz Drexx|owner's]] security.

==History==
This tower was built for [[Bezz Drexx]] and was filled with a guard on every level and the top level, Drexx's personal level, was fitted with [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]], and was the most protected area in the tower. It was often the used to have extravagant parties held by Bezz Drexx. Drexx's top level was Drexx's home and where he took bribes from [[Passel Argente's uncle]], until [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] [[Infiltration of Bezz Drexx's tower|caught them]] in the act and ruined Drexx.
